name: Fiber AI
summary: B2B company and people search, LinkedIn live enrichment, and email and phone reveal.
notes: Credit-priced: every call states its cost, and responses carry chargeInfo with what was billed. GET /v1/get-org-credits is free.
The docs show the key in the body (POST) or query (GET); the x-api-key header is documented as equivalent and is what this entry sends.
Cursor pagination: send the cursor from the previous response; pageSize is capped at 1000.
Rate limits are per operation (for example 180 per minute for searches, 120 for lookups).

endpoints.name: Get organization credits
endpoints.summary: Credits max, used and available for the organization, with the per-operation credit prices.

apiKey.description: Fiber API key; also sent in the x-api-key header by this entry, so usually left out.

notes: Free. Check it before chargeable calls.

endpoints.name: Search companies by filters
endpoints.summary: Filter-based company discovery: domain, location, headcount, industry, funding stage, keywords, founding date and more.

searchParams.description: Typed filters, all optional: exactCompanyV2, domains, headquartersCountryCode, headquartersStateName, employeeCountV2, employeeCountRanges, keywords, industriesV2, stage, totalFundingUSD, lastFundingUSD, lastFundedOn, foundedOn, nameLike, acceleratorsV2. Most take anyOf/noneOf lists or lowerBound/upperBound.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response.

companyExclusionListIDs.description: Company exclusion list ids whose members are filtered out.

includeCount.description: Also return an estimated total match count (one extra credit).

notes: A read over POST: the filters are in the body.
Costs 1 credit per company returned, plus 1 when includeCount is true. Paginate with cursor.
Use the free enum endpoints (industries, regions, technologies) to build valid filter values.

endpoints.name: Search people by filters
endpoints.summary: Filter-based prospect discovery by title, seniority, function, location, current company and keywords.

searchParams.description: Typed filters, all optional: country3LetterCode, numConnections, numFollowers, approxAge, keywords, keywordsV2, keywordSearchOptions, jobTitleV2, jobFunction, exactProfile, exactProfileV2, startedInRole, startedAtCompany, location.

currentCompanies.description: Restrict to people currently working at these companies (identified by domain, LinkedIn URL or org id).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response.

prospectExclusionListIDs.description: Prospect exclusion list ids to filter out.

companyExclusionListIDs.description: Company exclusion list ids; people at those companies are filtered out.

includeCount.description: Also return an estimated total match count (one extra credit).

notes: A read over POST: the filters are in the body.
Costs 1 credit per profile returned, plus 1 when includeCount is true. Paginate with cursor.
Search results carry no emails or phone numbers; use contacts.reveal for those.

endpoints.name: Search job postings
endpoints.summary: Job postings with flexible filters, useful as a hiring signal for companies.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response.

notes: A read over POST: the filters are in the body.
Costs 1 credit per job posting returned.

endpoints.name: Search companies or people in plain language
endpoints.summary: Free-form query such as 'Senior PMs at Series A fintechs in New York'; the API picks companies or people and builds the filters.

query.description: The natural-language query. Required on the first page.
query.example: VPs of Sales at fintech startups in NYC

pageToken.description: nextPageToken from the previous response; the query is then ignored.

notes: A read over POST.
First page costs 2 credits for interpreting the query, plus 1 credit per company or profile returned.

endpoints.name: Look up a company from any identifier
endpoints.summary: Full company record from a LinkedIn slug, URL or org id, a domain or a name.

companyIdentifier.description: {identifier, value}: identifier is linkedinSlug, linkedinUrl or linkedinOrgID. Most accurate.

companyName.description: {value}: the company name; all words must match.

companyDomain.description: {value}: the company domain; https and www are stripped.

notes: A read over POST.
2 credits per lookup. Prefer a LinkedIn identifier or domain over a bare name, which can collide.

endpoints.name: Look up a person from any identifier
endpoints.summary: Profile record from a LinkedIn URL or slug, an email, or a name with company details.

profileIdentifier.description: LinkedIn slug or URL as {identifier, value}. Best match accuracy.

personName.description: Person name for matching; best with companyDomain or companyIdentifier.

companyDomain.description: {value}: domain of the person's current company.

companyIdentifier.description: LinkedIn identifier of the current company.

liveFetch.description: Fetch the LinkedIn profile in real time (2 extra credits).

forceCompanyMatch.description: Require the match to work at the given company.

getDetailedEducation.description: Include school details per education entry.

getDetailedWorkExperience.description: Include company details per work experience.

notes: A read over POST.
2 credits per lookup. Returns no emails or phones; use contacts.reveal.

endpoints.name: Fetch a LinkedIn profile live
endpoints.summary: Fresh LinkedIn profile data: experience, education, skills and location.

identifier.description: LinkedIn slug, profile URL, Sales Navigator URN or numeric user id.

getDetailedEducation.description: Add school details; slows the call.

getDetailedWorkExperience.description: Add company details per job; slows the call.

notes: A read over POST.
2 credits per profile. No emails or phone numbers in the answer.

endpoints.name: Fetch a LinkedIn company live
endpoints.summary: Fresh LinkedIn company data, optionally with headcount history.

value.description: LinkedIn slug, URL, org id or Fiber company id, matching type.

getHistoricalHeadcount.description: Add total headcount over time and growth trends.

notes: A read over POST.
2 credits per company.

endpoints.name: Reveal a person's emails and phones
endpoints.summary: Work email, personal email and phone numbers for one LinkedIn profile, synchronously.

linkedinUrl.description: LinkedIn profile URL, slug, Sales Navigator URN or numeric user id.

enrichmentType.description: {getWorkEmails, getPersonalEmails, getPhoneNumbers}, booleans; you pay per selected type.

patience.description: How long to wait validating email deliverability; higher is slower and more accurate.

company.description: Optional current company; work emails on other domains go to unmatchedWorkEmails.

notes: A read over POST: it looks data up, though it spends credits.
Credits: 2 work email only, 2 personal only, 3 phone only, 3 all emails, 5 phones and emails.
Recommended client timeout is 2 minutes.

endpoints.name: Find a person from an email
endpoints.summary: The LinkedIn profile and details behind an email address.
notes: A read over POST.
2 credits per lookup; cached not-found answers are not billed.
Space requests evenly to avoid 429s.

endpoints.name: Find companies, schools or investors by name prefix
endpoints.summary: Partial-name search for companies, schools and investors, to get identifiers for filters.

orgType.description: Limit to one organization type; omit for all.

notes: A read over POST.
1 credit per request.

endpoints.name: Get a company's revenue estimate
endpoints.summary: Most recent annual revenue estimate for a company.

companyMetadata.description: {name, domain, linkedinUrl, linkedinOrgId}; give at least a LinkedIn URL or org id.

notes: A read over POST.
4 credits per lookup; nothing is charged when the company or estimate is not found.
